content:
maria_cs: Morning team — Batch 7 of the beta cohort is going live next Tue. Quick sync: enrollment straps are closed, but we need to confirm onboarding slots, survey cadence, and which accounts to flag for renewal-risk tracking.

maria_cs: Customers in batch 7: NimbusAI (intg work), Clearwell (SSO), FinchHealth (data retention), RookOps (high token usage). Mostly mid-market.

maria_cs: Proposed ops ->
```
- Tue 09:00 PT: live onboarding (recorded)
- Wed 11:00 PT: async office hours (drop-in)
- Fri 12:00 PT: short post-onboard micro-survey (NPS + 2 prod Qs)
```

maria_cs: Also want 1-pager for each customer: integration checklist + top 3 known issues. Can we have drafts by EOD Mon? :pray:

sam_se: @maria_cs I'm good to run the live onboarding at 09:00. Will include Q/A for SSO and token limits. Planning to reuse the payment flows snippet from last week. :white_check_mark:

alex_cs: I can draft the integration checklists — will add a short runbook for KV cache warmup and recommended quantization profile for RookOps. Will ping if I need model details.

julie_pm: I'll take the micro-survey design. Suggest we keep it 3 items: 1) overall satisfaction, 2) clarity of integration docs, 3) blocker severity. I'll wire it into our SurveyMonkey template and send sample by Tue morning. Thoughts?

maria_cs: Nice. Please make the second Q optional so infra teams can skip if not applicable.

ops_bot: Reminder: set beta_flag=true for NimbusAI, Clearwell, FinchHealth, RookOps. Also ensure ACR retention policy set to 90d for FinchHealth.

sam_se: @ops_bot thanks — done for NimbusAI and RookOps, queued for Clearwell (needs IAM owner approval).

alex_cs: IAM owner approval note: Clearwell requires SCIM mapping; I put the steps in the checklist draft (link coming).

julie_pm: For renewal-risk monitoring — proposal: mark FinchHealth as 'watch' due to retention compliance asks, and Clearwell as 'watch' until SCIM is complete. Anyone disagree?

maria_cs: Agree. Add a risk tag and set weekly check-ins for those two. I'll also add them to the renewal-risk dashboard for automated alerts (token spikes, error rates).

sam_se: One more ask: can we schedule a 30m internal prep on Mon 4pm PT to run through slides and handoff? I want to confirm demo prompts and fallbacks.

alex_cs: 4pm PT works for me. I'll bring the quick troubleshooting checklist.

julie_pm: Works for me too. I'll bring the survey wireframe and raw wording.

maria_cs: Thanks all. Action items summary:
- sam_se: run Tue 09:00 onboarding + join Mon prep (4pm PT)
- alex_cs: integration checklists + troubleshoot runbook (draft by Mon EOD)
- julie_pm: micro-survey + sample by Tue AM + join Mon prep
- maria_cs: add risk tags, enable dashboard alerts, collate 1-pagers
- ops_bot: ensure flags + retention policy (follow-ups noted)

maria_cs: If anyone hits blockers on docs, drop them here. Also, can someone record a 2-min clip on SSO troubleshooting for Clearwell? Could be a big help.

sam_se: I'll record the clip after the prep session and upload to the onboarding folder.

alex_cs: Uploaded checklist draft: https://redwood.internal/drive/d/abc123 (please review)

julie_pm: Survey sample: https://surveys.redwood/s/preview/xyz — open to edits, aiming to send Fri at 12:00 PT.

maria_cs: Nice work. :rocket: Last note — let's include a tiny reward incentive for the micro-survey (Amazon $10 e-gift) to boost response rate. Julie, can ops budget that?

julie_pm: I'll confirm with finance and update the thread by EOD.

maria_cs: Great. Last_message: prepping materials and recording tasklist — we'll reconvene in the Mon prep. Enjoy the weekend everyone. :wave:
